title: Hot Honey Roasted Almonds
steps: To a pan on medium heat add 1 cup raw almonds (150g), Dry roast for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Now push the almonds to the sides of the pan and reduce the heat to low, In the centre add 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp salt, Mix the honey and the masala’s really well, Toss the almonds in the honey mixture until evenly coated. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring continuously, Spread the almonds in a single layer on parchment or baking paper. Refrigerate for 15-20 minutes until the coating hardens. Break apart if needed and enjoy!
Storage: Store in an airtight container for a quick, crunchy snack.
assumptions: The creator also gives 19 g fibre.
The creator’s numbers are for the whole recipe, not one portion.
